Saptuam a la dingin Zeisu in meitung tuangin lei ah khatvei hong kumsukkik ding hi. Saptuam in upna hanga hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna ngahte hi. Tuni leh tu hun in hehpihna hun hi in, a sawtlo in bei ding hi. Saptuam, tapidaw, piangthak cih pen Pasian kammal zakna, upna leh hehpihna bek tawh piang hi. ### glossolalia
**[noun]** Glossolalia
**Meanings:** Glossolalia | Pautuamte. Greek glossa ‘tongue’ ; laleo, ‘to speak’, genkhia, pau cihna hi a, Khasiangtho letsongte sungah khat hi. Piangthakte sungah a kibuaipih leh pawlpi hong kikhensak kammal hi. Buaina khat pen tulai mite kampau dan maw, ahih keileh a kitheilo ahi bualbual maw, cih bangin ngaihsutna tuamtuam om hi. Pentecost Ni in Sawltakte in a kithei paute, known languages, pau-te a, Aramaic pau a theilote in lunglut mahmah hi (Sawl.2:5-13). Paul ngaihsutna ah pautuam pauna pen mihing tunga kigen hilo in Pasian tunga kigen leh kipau hizaw ahih manin ‘kuamah in a khiatna theilo hi’ (1Kor.14:2). Paul ngaihsutna ah pautuam pen midangte theih dingin kilet ding, kamphen om ding hi, ci hi (1Kor.14:5, 27-28). Pentecostalte (AGte) in kamtuam pauna in pianthakna lak hi. A piangthakte in kamtuam pau zatloh phamawhsak in sinlai uhhi. Kamtuam pauna pen Khasiangtho ngahna tawh kizom hi. Pianthak khit hun khat ciangin Khasiangtho khuanung tun ci a, Khasiangtho ngahna dingin thu nakpi in ngen in kamtuam pau zong kisinsak uhhi. Mi khat a pianthak leh kamtuam pau pau ding ci hi. Ahi zongin Tuiphumte in kamtuam pen niallo in pautuam hizaw hi, ci hi. A khiatna a khia thei ding mi 2 kisam ahih manin hih pen a kitello ahi bualbualte hilo ding hi. Laisiangtho kicingta ahih manin pautuam kisam nawnlo a, pawlpi kipna dingin Pasian in ama kammal bek zang hi. Pautuam leh kamtuam khiatna kilamdang mahmah hi. | glossolalia
**CEFR:** C2
> *Xenoglossia leh glossolalia pen bang cihna hiam?*
